records.summary: The records show 2127 Irving St is in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District (NCD-IRVING), where limited restaurants are principally permitted on the first floor. The most recent record at this exact address is a 2019 DPH approval for "Sip Tea 1011 SF," a limited restaurant (boba shop), which was exempt from neighborhood notice requirements. The immediate neighbor at 2123 Irving St operates as Bangkok House Thai Cuisine with an active Type 41 beer-and-wine license issued in 2021. Within 500 feet there are 22 registered food and drink businesses and 4 active ABC on-sale licenses; the density summary flags undue concentration as a potential concern for any future alcohol application, though this cafe concept serves no alcohol. The base-rate analysis shows zero dated use decisions within 1,000 feet in the last 10 years (N=0), so no approval rate can be calculated; however, dozens of agency referrals for restaurant continuations have been routinely approved on this block.

patterns.pattern: Limited restaurant and cafe uses are principally permitted in the NCD-IRVING district under Planning Code Section 732, and dozens of agency referrals for continuation of existing limited restaurants have been routinely approved on this corridor without neighborhood notice or Commission hearings.

Two recent formula retail CUA applications for food/beverage concepts on the same block (Mochi Donut Shop at 2126 Irving and Krispy Krunchy Chicken at 2130 Irving) were both cancelled in 2021–2022 within weeks to months of filing, without reaching a Commission hearing. The records do not state reasons for cancellation.

This suggests a pathway for cha…

Formula retail approvals in the NCD-IRVING corridor as recently as 2022 (bank branch at 2257 Irving) have been granted with standard conditions (signage program, community liaison, noise control, lighting, landscaping) but no specialized operational restrictions, showing the Commission will approve formula retail if the use meets Section 303.1 criteria.

Cafe and dessert uses requiring conditional use have historically been approved on the Irving Street corridor in the 1980s–1990s (ice cream/dessert at 2123 Irving in 1985, coffee shop at 1914-1920 Irving in 1995), though these predate the 2004–2008 formula retail restrictions.

One cafe CUA on the Irving corridor was denied in 1992 (bakery at 2227-2229 Irving St), but the record does not state the reason and the denial predates formula retail regulation. No other denials appear in the candidate set.

risk.concept_summary: A 1,000 sq ft, 20-seat formula retail cafe (boba shop, part of an 11-location chain) with limited cooking, no alcohol, and exterior signage at 2127 Irving St in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District.

overall.next_step: Confirm in writing with San Francisco Planning whether Planning Code Section 732 categorically prohibits formula retail limited restaurants in NCD-IRVING or whether a Conditional Use Authorization path exists, before signing a lease or paying application fees.

approvals.summary: Planning Code Section 732 states that formula retail is not permitted for Limited Restaurant use in NCD-IRVING; two recent formula retail cafe CUAs on this block were cancelled in 2021–2022, and a 2021 health referral stated formula retail use is not permitted in this district.

findings.text: Planning Code Section 732 in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District permits limited restaurants principally on the first floor but states that formula retail is not permitted for limited restaurant use as of the rules date July 30, 2024.

A Conditional Use Authorization for a formula retail mochi donut shop with drinks and snacks was filed at 2126 Irving St (46 m away) in November 2021 and cancelled in December 2021, 22 days after filing.
A Conditional Use Authorization for formula retail Krispy Krunchy Chicken was filed at 2130 Irving St (56 m away) in March 2021 and cancelled in January 2022, 314 days after filing.

In December 2021 Planning approved a health permit for The Mochi Donut Shop at 2126 Irving St and stated in the approval: 'Formula retail use not permitted within IRVING STREET NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL DISTRICT. The business is to use a standardized array of merchandise (50% or more of in-stock merchandise from a single distributor), additional standardized features would not be permitted.'

A formula retail bank branch received Conditional Use Authorization approval at 2257 Irving St (132 m away) in October 2022 under Planning Code Sections 178(3)(c), 303, and 303.1, showing formula retail CUAs have been granted on this corridor for other use types.

approvals.summary: A limited restaurant health permit to operate is issued after plan check and inspection without a hearing and is principally permitted; the most recent health approval at this address was for a boba shop in 2020.

findings.text: In January 2020 the Department of Public Health approved a limited restaurant health referral for Sip Tea 1011 SF at 2127 Irving St, stating the use is permitted in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District per Planning Code Section 732 and was exempt from neighborhood notice per Ordinance 199-18.
Limited restaurant health permits are routinely approved on this corridor as continuations of existing use, with dozens of agency referrals approved at addresses within 200 m in the last 10 years.

approvals.summary: Whether a building permit requires a change of occupancy depends on the occupant load worked out from plans and the existing occupancy group of the space, which public records do not show; tenant improvements for chain branding and equipment will require a building permit with plan review.

findings.text: The description states 20 seats and tenant improvements are planned, but a seat count is not the occupant load; the Building Code assigns Assembly Group A-2 to restaurants and Group B to spaces for fewer than 50 people, so whether the proposed occupancy is A-2 or B depends on the load calculation from the floor plan.

The description does not say whether the existing business (Sip Tea 1011 SF, approved 2020) is staying or whether the space is now vacant, and the existing occupancy group of the space is not in public records.

Tenant improvements for equipment updates and chain branding will trigger a building permit application routed to Planning, Public Health, Public Works, Fire, and PUC for review; the permit catalog estimates 14–120 days and $800–$15,000 in fees depending on construction valuation.

timeline_cost.notes: No timeline or cost range is given because Planning Code Section 732 states that formula retail is not permitted for limited restaurant use in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District, and the zoning row status is 'not permitted.' The pathway determination cites Planning Code Section 732 as barring the concept. Two recent formula retail cafe CUA applications on this block were cancelled in 2021–2022 without approval, and a 2021 health referral stated 'Formula retail use not permitted within IRVING STREET NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL DISTRICT.' The recommended next step is to confirm in writing with San Francisco Planning whether a CUA path exists before filing any application or paying any fee. If Planning confirms that no path exists, no approvals can be obtained and no time or cost applies. If Planning confirms that a CUA path exists despite the code table, then expect a Conditional Use Authorization timeline of approximately 120–300 days from pre-application to Commission hearing to effective date (including community outreach, environmental review, noticing, hearing scheduling, and the 30-day appeal period), with application fees starting around $3,100 for a CUA with no construction, plus costs for an architect, a signage program, community liaison services, and consultant fees, which are not government fees and are not estimated here.
